about: quranlab-contract sdk_4.0.0/LIVE_PROMOTION_41.md (section 30, SDK 4.0.5); made by tools/live41.py. takes: build a LiveTake with init, feed events in order, and compare the actions returned after event i with the entry [i, actions] of actions (no entry: none); expect is for reading.

takes.name: exact_at_pause
takes.about: A take 4.8 s in when the build is ready (exact replay); the first window is the newest 7 chunks both computed when the accelerator caught up; the commit chunk is a pause: the accelerator serves from the next chunk, about 0.1 s after the build was ready

takes.name: exact_waits_for_pause
takes.about: The commit chunk and the next ones are mid-letter: the swap waits for the first pause (3 chunks on), nothing is replaced

takes.name: word_bar_is_a_pause
takes.about: A chunk ending in blank then the word bar is a pause

takes.name: no_pause_cap
takes.about: No pause after the commit (a held madd): at 8 s of audio from the commit chunk (25 chunks at c16) the swap is made anyway; a healthy take never stays on the CPU for lack of a pause

takes.name: short_take_window_fills
takes.about: Ready 0.7 s in: fewer than 7 chunks exist; the window is chunks 0 to 6, judged when both engines have chunk 6

takes.name: ready_at_take_start
takes.about: Ready before the first chunk of a take that started on the CPU (the build warmed a moment too late): nothing to replay yet; the window is chunks 0 to 6

takes.name: c24_exact
takes.about: c24_l72: 5-chunk windows, a pause every third chunk

takes.name: inexact_first_window
takes.about: A 45 s take (141 chunks): the replay starts 30 s back (not exact); the first window is the replay's newest 7 chunks, past the accelerator's first 33

takes.name: inexact_third_window
takes.about: Not exact: the first two windows outside the tolerance, the third within: commit

takes.name: inexact_mismatch
takes.about: Not exact: three windows outside: mismatch_inexact, the take stays on the CPU, the record as a deadline miss

takes.name: exact_mismatch
takes.about: Exact: the one window outside the tolerance: mismatch, a disagreement in the record

takes.name: window_failed
takes.about: The window's accelerator chunks held a NaN: accel_failed, whatever the values

takes.name: fails_in_replay
takes.about: The accelerator throws during the replay: accel_failed before any window

takes.name: stall_at_ready
takes.about: The build is ready while the take is late (a chunk handed out more than a chunk after its audio): no attempt until a chunk on time, then the attempt starts

takes.name: stall_held
takes.about: The take stays late to its end: no attempt; the tally holds it under stall

takes.name: stall_at_commit
takes.about: Committed while the take is late: the swap waits for a pause handed out on time

takes.name: stalled
takes.about: Late from the commit on for 20 s of audio (63 chunks at c16): the attempt ends stalled

takes.name: interrupted_mid_attempt
takes.about: A call interrupts the take during the replay; no swap while it lasts; after it, the first chunk on time that is a pause

takes.name: thermal_aborts
takes.about: The thermal state turns serious during the replay: aborted, the take stays on the CPU

takes.name: unready_aborts
takes.about: The build is released during the attempt: aborted

takes.name: take_ends_during_attempt
takes.about: The app finishes the take during the replay: aborted, the last chunk the CPU's

takes.name: config_off
takes.about: flags.live_promotion false: no attempt; held under config_off

takes.name: app_cpu
takes.about: The app asked for the CPU engine: no attempt and nothing counted

takes.name: low_power_then_off
takes.about: Low Power Mode when ready, turned off later in the take: the attempt starts then

takes.name: near_limit
takes.about: Ready after 1,140 s of the take: no attempt, held under near_limit

takes.name: near_source_end
takes.about: A file take with 9 s of its source left: no attempt

takes.name: fast_source
takes.about: Samples read as fast as possible: never a stall; the swap at the first pause

takes.name: in_flight_cpu_dropped
takes.about: A CPU chunk computed after the swap (in flight) is dropped, never handed out

takes.name: failover_after_swap
takes.about: Swapped, then the accelerator fails at chunk 30: the 2.0.2 failover takes the take back (its own rules); the seconds after the swap count to the failed chunk
